findings.namedBuyers: Agathe Lairy: ISVV Head of International Relations; university profile says she jointly steers OENOVITI activities with Pierre-Louis Teissedre; foundation lists her as project manager. Best operational relationship-development contact. Pierre-Louis Teissedre: Professor, Head/Coordinator of OENOVITI International; relevant senior sponsor and route to the coordination office. Marie Arduin is additionally named in the 2026 official programme as OENOVITI network team. None is verified as the 2027 hotel contracting signatory or budget holder; participant-direct bookings mean there may be no centralized room-block buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition: 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland; theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing environmental, social and human challenges. These are activity dates, explicitly stated by the organizer and Agroscope, not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. Registration is announced to open 1 December 2026. No official 2028 dates, city or venue were located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a geographically credible Founex/La Côte accommodation alternative for this Nyon-hosted scientific gathering, rather than downtown-Geneva or Lausanne overflow. The 2026 organizer reported 97 participants; this is historical attendance, not a 2027 forecast or room count. It suggests a potentially manageable scale but does not establish lodging demand, overnight share or a 20-room minimum. Pursue only a modest, verified room requirement within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room commercial band, not a whole-house assumption. Its meeting facilities could suit ancillary workshops if requested; the main event venue is already selected. This is research/education demand, not a resort-led programme; rooftop/F&B would be optional add-ons, not evidenced requirements.
findings.venueCommitments: Agroscope explicitly lists Location: Changins. Hosts/co-organizers are Changins | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie and Agroscope with OENOVITI International. Venue city: Nyon; region: Vaud / La Côte; country: Switzerland. This is in the hotel’s primary Nyon/La Côte territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. Changins school address is Route de Duillier 50, 1260 Nyon; this is an institutional address, not a verified event-specific entrance. Exact auditorium/building is unverified. Public venue announcement establishes the selected site, not disclosure of a signed contract. Changins is an educational venue, not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified international rotation: 11–15 May 2023, Kyoto/Yamanashi/Niigata, Japan; 14–15 May 2024, Asti University Campus / Uni-Astiss, Asti, Italy; 22–23 May 2025, BOKU, Vienna, Austria; 20–22 May 2026, University of Porto Faculty of Sciences, Porto, Portugal; announced 19–21 May 2027, Changins, Nyon, Switzerland. The series explicitly describes annual symposium/assembly activity. This supports recurrence, not annual Nyon demand or a confirmed Swiss return.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Verified participant-direct booking with an edition-specific recommended hotel, not unknown lodging arrangements. Organizer quote: "OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings" and "We recommend booking your accommodation at Hôtel B&B NYON". The only hotel named for 2027 is Hôtel B&B NYON / B&B HOTEL Nyon, 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon; participant identification code NOVITI27. Organizer states: "Activities will depart and return to this location." Agroscope explicitly adds: "You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs." No published guaranteed block, allocation size, rate, release date, housing bureau or open hotel RFP was located. Recommendation plus code is not evidence of contracted room inventory or exclusivity.
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI International is an academic/research and industry network coordinated by University of Bordeaux / ISVV, not evidenced as a commercial PCO/DMC. Its Executive Committee oversees network operations; its Bordeaux coordination office is explicitly the main contact for event organization. ADERA collects membership fees, manages network finances and supports project management; that does not establish hotel procurement authority. For 2027, Agroscope and Changins are local co-organizers/hosts. No separate housing agency or PCO was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B HOTEL Nyon has a specific 2027 recommendation, NOVITI27 code and the event activity departure/return point. These are meaningful competitive advantages over an unlisted Founex hotel. No evidence of B&B sell-out, overflow need, dissatisfaction, guaranteed inventory or exclusive accommodation commitment was found. No room-night, peak-room or 2027 attendance figure was located. Do not equate 97 historical participants with 97 guestrooms or convert the three-day event into a fixed stay length.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Agathe Lairy through the published OENOVITI office, copying or requesting introduction to Pierre-Louis Teissedre, before the announced 1 December 2026 registration opening. Acknowledge B&B Nyon as the recommended hotel and activity hub. Ask whether organizers will circulate a non-exclusive alternative, whether speaker/staff rooms are centrally paid, and the expected non-local overnight count, stay dates, budget and existing B&B allocation/release terms. Confirm exact Changins building and whether YOTEL guests can join departures at B&B or need a separate transfer. Only then offer a right-sized rate/availability proposal; do not assert an RFP or overflow need. If no material 2027 need exists, retain as local-host/network relationship development.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is a live but constrained alternative-accommodation relationship opportunity, not a verified open sourcing lead. Participants may choose another hotel, so access is not closed; however the recommended hotel and transport/activity hub are already established elsewhere. Main-venue displacement should not be pursued. Qualification as a material lodging lead requires organizer willingness to circulate an alternative plus an evidenced overnight requirement and workable transfers.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build a relationship with the Bordeaux coordination office and local hosts for later Swiss-hosted meetings, smaller working groups or a future return. Annual international rotation is verified, but no 2028 destination/date or future Nyon return was located. Do not present an annual local room block or a future Swiss competitive bid as announced business.
